title: molchat-manifest.json
description: Integrity manifest of a vendored MolChat copy (schema moldesign.molchat/1, PLAN Fase 6). Produced by scripts/make_manifest.py from a clean commit; consumed by the MolDesign host before every sidecar launch. The host implements the checks in code (no JSON Schema dependency at runtime); this file is the shared contract of what those checks enforce.

schema.description: Manifest schema identity. A host that does not know this exact value must abstain, never guess.

programa.description: Human name of the vendored program.

version.description: Package version (SemVer), equal to both [project] version and __version__ of the vendored commit.

licencia_spdx.description: SPDX identifier; the file named by licencia_texto must carry exactly that license text.

licencia_texto.description: Manifest-relative path of the license text (verified by hash, LF-normalized).

commit.description: Commit the vendored blobs were read from (git objects, never the worktree).

rama.description: Branch that commit was on when staged.

repositorio.description: Public repository URL without credentials (the GPL source offer). https only.

invocacion.description: How the host launches the sidecar (loopback process, ephemeral port, scoped token).

no_se_enlaza.description: Boundary statement: no imports either way, HTTP contract only.

agente_plataforma.description: Agent-platform HTTP contract the vendored sidecar speaks.

min_moldesign.description: Minimum MolDesign release carrying the host surface. Omitted while no released MolDesign carries it.

dependencias.description: Runtime dependencies the host interpreter must provide (base plus server extra).

excluidos.description: What exists in the source repo but deliberately does not travel, with the reason for each.

archivos.description: Manifest-relative paths (posix separators) to exact byte counts and SHA-256 hashes.

sha256_conjunto.description: Set fingerprint over sorted paths and hashes; changes if a byte, a name, or the list changes.
